about: Every frame of the paper's formal label set: scene (configuration, seed, relief a and H, random fault count), fracture parameters, light, render settings and the camera shot (metres, east-north-up). camera_slot: the camera slot of `fracgen frame` whose plan camera has this shot, empty when the camera is not a plan camera (close-range and near views). scene_options and frame_options: the options of `fracgen scene CONFIG ...` and `fracgen frame SCENE ...` that regenerate the frame (add --out and, for rendering, --device).
